updates.content:
Title: Admins can't manage drivers from the Windows Autopatch groups tab

User impact: Admins can't manage drivers from the Autopatch groups tab.

More info: As a temporary alternative while we validate and deploy our long-term remediation, admins may manage drivers directly through the associated driver policy.

Current status: We've developed a fix and are validating its efficacy prior to deployment in the affected environments.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and admins attempting to manage drivers through Autopatch are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, August 7, 2026, at 1:30 AM UTC

Title: Admins can't manage drivers from the Windows Autopatch groups tab

User impact: Admins can't manage drivers from the Autopatch groups tab.

More info: As a temporary alternative while we validate and deploy our long-term remediation, admins may manage drivers directly through the associated driver policy.

Current status: We've determined that a recent standard service update contained a code regression and is resulting in admins being unable to manage drivers from the Windows Autopatch groups tab. We've validated the efficacy of our fix and aim to confirm a remediation timeline by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and admins attempting to manage drivers through Autopatch are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Friday, July 24, 2026, at 4:38 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent standard service update contained a code regression and is resulting in admins being unable to manage drivers from the Windows Autopatch groups tab.

Next update by: Friday, August 7, 2026, at 3:30 AM UTC
